data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 甲板上的灯
data.description: 夜班开始前，贝尔法斯特站在甲板边检查远处的港灯，海风掠过她的发尾。
data.promptProse: Before her night watch begins aboard the moored naval vessel, Belfast stands along the outer steel deck in her crisp royal maid uniform with one hand resting lightly on the cold railing. She looks calmly across the dark harbor toward the distant navigation beacons while the evening sea breeze lifts the ends of her hair and apron ribbons. Shimmering ribbons of warm harbor light stretch across the dark water behind her.
data.animaCaption: Standing along the moored ship deck with one hand resting on the railing, Belfast looks calmly out toward the distant harbor lights. Evening sea breeze stirs her hair as warm beacon lights shimmer across the dark water.
